# fopost_label (Resource)

A FoPost label: the campaign tag posts are grouped and reported by. Deleting a label unlinks it from every post carrying it; the posts themselves are untouched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fopost_workspace" "acme" {
  name = "Acme Social"
  slug = "acme-social"
}

resource "fopost_label" "launch" {
  workspace_id = fopost_workspace.acme.id
  name         = "Launch Week"
  color        = "#2563eb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String) Hex color the label is drawn in, e.g. `#2563eb`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the label.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the label belongs to. A label cannot move between workspaces, so changing this replaces the label.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the label was created.
- `id` (String) The label's server-assigned identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the label.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import fopost_label.launch lbl_01hzy8example
```
